qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Near-monopoly in North American P25 mission-critical public safety LMR infrastructure and APX handsets. Insurmountable switching costs stem from life-critical reliability requirements, multi-jurisdiction radio interoperability, and deep integration with 911 dispatch and CAD/RMS software. Empirically demonstrated by 10-year GAAP ROIC averaging >35%, operating margins expanding from 17.4% to 25.6%, and record $15.7B order backlog. Erosion risks include regulatory scrutiny on sole-source government contracts (e.g. UK Airwave price caps) and eventual long-term convergence with broadband/cellular push-to-talk standards.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Entrenched global leader in mission-critical public safety radio, video security, and 911 command center software with high switching barriers and a record $15.7B backlog. Beneficiary of US NDAA exclusions against Chinese competitors and secular demand for automated emergency response. Multi-cycle cash conversion >100% and robust interest coverage (8.3x EBIT/interest) provide financial resilience despite Silvus acquisition debt. [5-10Y g: LMR/video volume 4.0% + contractual pricing 2.0% + software mix 1.5% - UK Airwave regulatory drag 0.5% + share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 37.7% and tangible ROIC >50%. FY2025 revenue reached $11.68B (+8% YoY) with EBIT of $2.99B (25.6% margin). Net income of $2.15B converted into $2.28B of Owner FCF (106% conversion). Net debt of $7.25B following the $4.4B Silvus Technologies acquisition is covered in 3.36x normal net earnings, with interest coverage of 8.3x. Order backlog reached an all-time high of $15.7B at year-end 2025.
